item.title: Organizational Structure
item.description: Function Overview linkOrganizational structure is used to manage the organizations, member accounts and measurement groups on the platform. The left side shows the organization tree; after selecting an organization, you can switch between Member List, Organization Information and Measurement Group on the right. Member List: view and manage the member accounts under the current organization Organization Information: view and modify the current organization, and create subordinate organizations Measurement Group: divide the device measurement points into groups to control which parameters a member can see on the device details page The organizations you can see and operate in the tree depend on your roles and permissions; subordinate organizations and their members are created and maintained by the superior organization.

item.title: Manager Assistant
item.description: Function Overview linkThe person in charge of an organization usually has to maintain the member accounts of the organization (add members, modify information, reset passwords, disable accounts, etc.). When the person in charge is on a business trip, on leave or busy with other things, one member of the organization can be designated to handle these tasks instead. That designated member is the Manager Assistant. Person in charge: the account automatically created by the platform when the organization is created.
